content.short: Starton provides resilient, high-performance development tools for Web3 projects.
content.description: Starton offers a unified API intended to simplify the development of new projects based on the EVM, helping teams avoid wasted time, money, or resources. The API handles the integration work, enabling faster and more efficient development across projects and networks. By abstracting common setup and interaction tasks, Starton supports a smoother development workflow and consistent access to essential blockchain features. Whether building from the ground up or expanding existing apps, developers can rely on a single, cohesive API surface to manage requests, adapt to network changes, and maintain quality as their product evolves.
content.meta: Starton offers a unified API to accelerate EVM-based project development. Discover Starton and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
